figuren.name: Köderwart Empörlich

bild.cell_semantics: logical layout only; not certified crop

figuren.temperament: Knows the catch is ready when it calls itself an independent response.
figuren.prompt_auszug: Köderwart Empörlich, maennlich-read. tall slender hooked ink splat,small battered fisher cap and little canvas pocket; ONE short curved fishing rod held beside body with short line ending in a little RED BOXING-GLOVE LURE safely within cell,no hook detail,no other creature. Avid uneven eyes tracking lure,huge crooked open grin with TWO upper teeth. Personality: Knows the catch is ready when it calls itself an independent response.
